name: DogTheNaughtyHunter
tagline: Screens your X account for coordinated fake-account swarms worth a closer look
description: Point it at the X account you are signed into and it walks your notifications and follower surface looking for signs of coordinated inauthentic activity. Suspected swarm accounts collect onto a running roster that you can interrogate at your own pace, and nothing new joins the list until you have signed off on it.
author: TheRetardedELon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
